title: Claude Code Tresor Agent Frontmatter
description: Schema for agent.md YAML frontmatter. Only fields Claude Code reads are allowed, because agents load straight from these files as plugins. Team and category come from the folder path.

name.description: Agent identifier, kebab-case. Must match parent directory name.

tools.description: Tool list. Array form is preferred; comma-separated string is accepted for legacy agents.

maxTurns.description: Maximum agentic turns before the agent stops.
